environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a public subnet with internet gateway. The container runs as root with default Docker seccomp profile. The /tmp filesystem is a shared Docker volume (rw) mounted across sidecar containers in the same task definition. Kafka brokers are accessible via public MSK bootstrap endpoints. The callback URL points to an internal ALB but the task has a public IP and accepts inbound connections. No filesystem isolation between containers in the task.

config.tmp_volume: shared ephemeral volume across task containers
config.security_group: sg-0a1b2c3d4e (inbound 0.0.0.0/0 all ports, outbound 0.0.0.0/0 all ports)
